message.content: You are at Step 6. e2e/reports.spec.ts carries its viewport pin and two test() blocks…

The audit is right, and it is not saying the dwell is missing. `payoffHold` is declared at the top of the file, so the PW_PROVE_CLIP-gated wait sits OUTSIDE every test() body — the dwell exists, it is just hoisted.

The fix is to inline it in each test(): delete the helper, and put the `// JUSTIFIED:` comment plus the gated `await page.waitForTimeout(2500)` at the end of every test() block it holds. Then re-run the clip-fidelity audit and expect exit 0.
Different spec, same step. Every test() in e2e/checkout.spec.ts ends with the ungated centring…

The two-line split is fine. The clip-fidelity audit exits 0, and the spec needs no edit.

That skipping is deliberate and load-bearing: the doc comment in `findDwells` records that the unbraced branch once searched from the character right after the closing paren, which is the newline in this shape, so the region collapsed and the wait went invisible. Eleven sessions hit it and four agents worked around it by joining the two lines. That is the move to avoid here — churning a passing spec to appease a bug that was fixed teaches the wrong shape.

So: run it as-is, keep the viewport pin, and move on to Step 7.
